title: Persistent Recurrent Memory Between Transformer Layers - Improves Language Model Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.17251v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a simple architectural modification to decoder-only transformers: a persistent recurrent state that observes hidden representations via cross-attention, updates itself through a GRU, and modulates subsequent processing via gated addition. Inserted between the lower and upper halves of a 6-layer transformer, this module adds only 3.7\% additional parameters while reducing evaluation loss from $2.438 \pm 0.004$ to $1.743 \pm 0.018$, corresponding to a 28.5\% reduction on held-out language modeling data. The improvement is statistically significant across 5 random seeds ($p < 0.01$) and corresponds to reduced overfitting (generalization gap 0.12 vs 0.26). Through controlled ablations, we demonstrate that the improvement stems entirely from the persistent memory topology, not from auxiliary self-prediction objectives. translated_title: Transformer层间的持久循环记忆——提升语言模型的泛化能力
translated_abstract: 我们对仅解码器Transformer架构引入了一种简单的修改：一个持久循环状态，通过交叉注意力观察隐藏表示，通过GRU进行自我更新，并通过门控加法调制后续处理。将该模块插入6层Transformer的下半部分与上半部分之间，仅增加3.7%的额外参数，即可将评估损失从2.438±0.004降低至1.743±0.018，在留出的语言建模数据上相当于28.5%的性能提升。该改进在5个随机种子上具有统计学显著性（p < 0.01），并对应于过拟合的减少（泛化差距从0.26降至0.12）。通过受控消融实验，我们证明该改进完全源于持久记忆拓扑结构，而非辅助自预测目标。具有相同拓扑结构但无辅助损失的模型表现相当，而随机辅助损失则……
tldr: 在Transformer层间插入基于GRU的持久循环记忆模块，仅增加3.7%的参数即可将语言建模的泛化损失降低28.5%，且消融实验证明改进完全来自持久记忆拓扑结构本身而非辅助损失。
en_tdlr: Inserting a persistent recurrent memory module (updated via GRU and cross-attention) between transformer layers reduces language modeling loss by 28.5% with only 3.7% additional parameters, with ablations showing the improvement stems entirely from the persistent memory topology rather than auxiliary objectives.
